name: cardoai-client-plugins

plugins.name: prism-analyst
plugins.description: Verified retrieval for Prism deals/transactions. Bundles two skills for side-by-side benchmarking: prism-analyst (v4.0.0, session-orchestrated, one worker agent per wave) and prism-analyst-lite-v5 (v5.0.0, experimental - table-first retrieval, inline by default). Connects to the Prism MCP server.
